title: Semi-Slav Defense: Botvinnik Variation
line: Black takes on c4 and keeps it, while White attacks on the kingside. Sharp for both.

steps.text: The Queen's Gambit, and Black guards the center pawn with the pawn on c6.
Black adds the king pawn: the Semi-Slav. White's bishop pins the knight to the queen.
Take the pawn on c4, which nothing guards.
steps.after: White takes the center with its king pawn.

steps.text: Push the pawn on b7 two squares to hold on to the pawn on c4.
steps.after: White pushes the pawn on and attacks your pinned knight.

steps.text: Push the pawn on h7 one square to chase the bishop.
Push the pawn on g7 two squares. It attacks the bishop on h4 again.
steps.after: This is the Botvinnik Variation. White gives a knight to keep the attack going.

steps.text: Take the knight with the pawn. You are a piece up for now.
steps.after: White's bishop takes back and pins your knight again.

steps.text: Bring the other knight out. It guards the knight on f6.
steps.after: White can take the knight on f6 next. Both sides attack, and both kings can come under fire.

summary: Black grabs a pawn and holds it with the queenside pawns. White sacrifices to attack. Both kings are in danger.
